responding_to.type: passengers trapped on bus by rising water

output.english: This is a practice flood alert for Richmond, VA. Rising water is trapping people in Shockoe Bottom and at Riverside Apartments, with dangers near Downtown Junction, East Junction, and Broad and 3rd. Avoid Dock St and Lee Bridge and do not walk or drive through flood water.
output.spanish: Este es un mensaje de práctica sobre inundaciones en Richmond, VA. El agua está subiendo en Shockoe Bottom y en Riverside Apartments, con peligros cerca de Downtown Junction, East Junction y Broad and 3rd. Evite Dock St y Lee Bridge y no camine ni maneje en el agua.
